# Tender response -- PKHYVA-2026-0087

## Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services contractor based in Jyvaskyla, active in LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance across public and private contracts in Central Finland.

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy meets the required electrical contracting class for this procurement.

### Technical response

Unresolved faults are handled through an escalation procedure with defined stages, moving from the site team to management if a fault is not resolved within the expected window. Elevator servicing is carried out in line with the applicable statutory regime, with inspection records kept on file. Spare parts are sourced against a stated lead time depending on the part and manufacturer. Fire-protection systems are maintained on a scheduled interval consistent with system type. Fault call-outs receive a 4-hour emergency response, supported by an on-call duty roster covering all contract properties around the clock. The property register and documentation are handed over in full at contract expiry, including maintenance history and as-built records.

### Commercial terms

Pricing is index-linked annually against the relevant cost index. The contract runs for 5 years with the extension option described in Section 5, on terms to be agreed with the contracting authority ahead of expiry.

**Note on warranty period.** Section 5.5 of the notice states a 24-month warranty on installed equipment from acceptance. Annex B states a 12-month warranty from delivery for the same equipment. Visakoivu Oy is submitting a written question to the contracting authority to clarify which period applies and will confirm on receipt of the answer; our pricing assumes the longer of the two stated terms.

### Annex A -- technical specification

The building automation system supports BACnet and Modbus for integration with existing systems, allowing the maintained equipment to interoperate with the county's existing building management infrastructure.

### Annex B -- commercial and forms

A service-level penalty clause applies where agreed service levels are not met, in line with the terms of this annex. Visakoivu Oy confirms the confidentiality undertaking required under this annex, covering all information obtained in the course of this contract.

### Forms

A certificate of insurance is enclosed with this tender.

### Pricing

Prices are quoted excluding VAT, in EUR, on a per-property basis.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to bid for this framework agreement.
